title: Practice the bishop's diagonal move.
goal: Move your bishop from the square c1 to the square g5 in one move.
narration_seed: Bishops travel along diagonals and stay on one color of squares.
hints: Move the bishop along the clear diagonal that rises to the right from the square c1.
solution_text: Move your bishop from the square c1 to the square g5.
success_text: You placed your bishop on the square g5.
failure_text: Keep your bishop on the diagonal that begins at the square c1.
